Step: Case 1: v_{2r} ≤ 2^{n-r}: use IH + v_{2r}: sum ≤ 2^n - 2^{n-r+1} + 2^{n-r} = 2^n - 2^{n-r}. Good.

Upper bound: check the greedy cancellation produces pieces that then get sorted; Lemma 3 requires the multiset partitioned into equal pairs plus leftover L. Now, δ(final) ≤ 1/N ⇒ odd(S) = (1+δ)/2 ≤ (1+1/N)/2 = (N+1)/(2N) = 2^{n+1}/(2N) = 2^n/N. Good.
